## Details

<a id="scene0_maps_packed"></a>
### [`scene0_maps_packed`](../../../../src/scenes/scene_maps_packed_a.asm#L6) `$68CB-$6B40`

*data*

The low nibble of a byte comes first, then the high nibble. A count nibble 1-7 copies that many nibbles that follow it. A count nibble 9-15 repeats the next nibble (count AND 7) times. A count nibble 0 ends a pass.

- **Entry of:** [`scene_map_packed_ptrs`](../../tables.md#scene_map_packed_ptrs)

### [`scene1_maps_packed`](../../../../src/scenes/scene_maps_packed_a.asm#L87) `$6B41-$6D95`

*data*

The data ends with the low nibble of $6d95. Its high nibble $a is fill that nothing uses.
